newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Health Management Associates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Health Management Associates.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said on Thursday it was initiating coverage of Health Management Associates Inc with a buy rating and a 12-month price target of $35 per share.

-- The health-care provider's high valuation is well-deserved because of its strong growth rate, profitability and financial condition, and because of the competitive position of its hospitals, analyst Thomas McGinnis Jr said in a research note.
-- McGinnis said the company's strategy was to operate hospitals in non-urban communities, an area that offered significant business opportunities.

-- "Hospitals in small cities are much less affected by competition, managed care and unions than hospitals in major metropolitan areas," he said. Patient migration to urban areas had fallen amid advances in lower-cost technology, a physician surplus and more professional management of non-urban hospitals, he said.
-- Health Management shares were off 1-1/2 at 29-7/8 early Thursday afternoon.
